business_summary: Daiwa Securities Living Investment Corporation based on the provisions of the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations and listed as a housing-specific REIT on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Real Estate Investment Trust market on June 22, 2006. The Investment Corporation merged with Prospect Reit Investment Corporation in an absorption-type merger on July 1, 2010, and since then it has been seeking to steadily enhance distributions primarily by improving the quality of its portfolio through the replacement of properties (acquiring new properties and disposing of existing properties), strengthening overall operations by improving occupancy rates and other factors, and reducing costs by decreasing expenses for interest-bearing debt and other items. Furthermore, as a result of an absorption-type merger (hereinafter the Merger) whereby the Investment Corporation is the surviving corporation and Nippon Healthcare Investment Corporation (hereinafter NHI) is the absorbed corporation on April 1, 2020, upon which the trade name was changed from Japan Rental Housing Investments Inc. to Daiwa Securities Living Investment Corporation and healthcare facilities were added to the portfolio, the Investment Corporation is now managed as a REIT that comprehensively provides comfortable living spaces that support life and lifestyle of everyone suited to each life stage. The properties under management at the end of September 2025 consisted of 243 properties with a total acquisition price of 399,139 yen million and a total rentable floor area of 742,455.67 square meters. Daiwa Securities Living Investment Corporation was established on October 07, 2005 and incorporated in Japan.
business_summary_ko: 다이와 증권 리빙 투자 주식회사는 투자 신탁 및 투자 회사에 관한 법률의 규정에 의거하여 2006년 6월 22일 도쿄 증권 거래소 부동산 투자 신탁 시장에 주택 전용 REIT로 상장되었습니다. 투자 회사는 2010년 7월 1일 흡수식 합병으로 Prospect Reit Investment Corporation과 합병되었으며, 이후 부동산 교체(신규 부동산 취득 및 부동산 취득)를 통해 주로 포트폴리오의 질을 향상시키는 등 꾸준한 배당 강화를 추구해 왔습니다. 기존부동산 매각), 입주율 개선 등을 통해 전반적인 운영을 강화하고, 이자부채 등 비용 절감을 통해 비용을 절감하고 있습니다. 또한, 2020년 4월 1일자로 투자법인을 존속법인으로 하고 일본헬스케어투자공사(이하 NHI)를 흡수법인으로 하는 흡수합병(이하 합병)에 따라 상호를 일본임대주택투자주식회사에서 다이와증권 생활투자주식회사로 변경하고 의료시설을 포트폴리오에 추가하였습니다.
